text.en: The coasts and natural resources of Atlantic Canada made those provinces an important part of the country's history and its growth.
text.fr: Les côtes et les ressources naturelles du Canada atlantique ont fait de ces provinces une part importante de l'histoire et de l'essor du pays.

source.quote: have made these provinces an important part of Canada’s history and development.

text.en: Newfoundland and Labrador is known for its natural beauty. The province also has a heritage of its own that is tied to the sea.
text.fr: Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador est reconnue pour sa beauté naturelle. La province possède aussi un patrimoine bien à elle, lié à la mer.

source.quote: In addition to its natural beauty, the province has a unique heritage linked to the sea.

text.en: For a long time, Newfoundland and Labrador has been known for a culture of its own, for its fishing villages along the coast and for its fisheries.
text.fr: Depuis longtemps, Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador est reconnue pour une culture bien à elle, pour ses villages de pêche sur la côte et pour ses pêcheries.

source.quote: the province has long been known for its fisheries, coastal fishing villages and distinct culture.

text.en: Prince Edward Island is known for its red soil and for farming. The crop it is best known for is the potato.
text.fr: L'Île-du-Prince-Édouard est reconnue pour sa terre rouge et pour l'agriculture. La pomme de terre est la culture qui l'a le plus fait connaître.

source.quote: red soil and agriculture, especially potatoes.

text.en: Anne of Green Gables is a story many readers love. It follows the adventures of a small orphan girl with red hair.
text.fr: Anne of Green Gables est un récit que bien des lecteurs adorent. Il raconte les aventures d'une petite orpheline aux cheveux roux.

source.quote: is a much-loved story about the adventures of a little red-headed orphan girl.
